title: GUARD (fixed in 5538e5f86b) — was: a nested _values/_alternative action makes zsh report 'bad option'; zshrs completes silently

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(compsys): a nested `_alternative` action swallowed the options it was handed instead of reporting them
retired.why: the native _alternative port (src/compsys/ported/Base/Utility/_alternative.rs) now walks the options it is handed with a shared port of bin_getopts (src/compsys/ported/shared.rs), the same loop the shell _alternative runs through `zparseopts`/getopts, so a nested action's `-J -a -d -e -f -l -t -u --` produce the nine `_alternative:7: bad option:` diagnostics this fixture recorded as only-zsh.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand by scripts/compsys_regressions.py --variants --confirm-moved 3 at 0b11157986: the fixture cell scored NOW-PASSES four times (both shells report the nine `_alternative:7: bad option:` diagnostics), and every variant/control agreed. The runner reported the binary CHANGED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> dde9ed4252d2e7e5), the 'somebody fixed the bug' branch the README names.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file: the cell stays in the evidence base and the gate now FAILS if the divergence comes back.

guard_verified.against: debug build of 0b11157986 with 5538e5f86b reverse-applied (113783536 bytes, sha256 f10fb72dd6e7d24e) — carries the bug
guard_verified.note: pointed the gate at a build of 0b11157986 with 5538e5f86b reverse-applied (git archive export, own CARGO_TARGET_DIR, sha256 f10fb72dd6e7d24e): `compsys_regressions.py --zshrs <that build> --only alternative_nested_action_bad_option --variants`. It reported CONTROL-MOVED with the same harness detail observed_when_diverging records, so the guard fails on THIS bug.

observed.measured: 2026-09-14, commit 0b11157986, a codesigned byte-identical copy of target/debug/zshrs passed with --zshrs (zshrs 0.12.64, 113648832 bytes, sha256 dde9ed4252d2e7e5) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: both shells report the nine `_alternative:7: bad option:` diagnostics; the grids agree.

observed_when_diverging.notes: zsh rejects the option letters the nested action passes through and prints nine 'bad option' diagnostics instead of a list; zshrs accepts them and renders the matches.
observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: commit 3b4a01f0cd, target/debug/zshrs zshrs 0.12.49 (101601256 bytes, 2026-08-30 05:50:47, sha256 6420c23cecc13c35), zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0) — the divergence AS MEASURED BEFORE 5538e5f86b. It is history, not current behaviour; the fixture now asserts the two shells AGREE.

variants.note: WHEN THIS FIXTURE DIVERGED: superset witness, confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 24 rows differ): the same nine 'bad option' diagnostics PLUS the escaped-colon 'command not found: b' of fixture alternative_escaped_colon_split.  NOW: agrees (NOW-PASSES x4; harness detail 'both shells report' the same diagnostics).
